<title>MV THA – แผนผังระบบไฟฟ้า</title>

<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#0b1118;--bar:#121a24;--fg:#e6edf5;--mut:#8f9db0;--line:#263243;--acc:#5aa9ff;--hit:#1a2433;--ok:#35d070;--bad:#ff5c5c;--warn:#f0b429}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans Thai",Sarabun,sans-serif;overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:none}
body{padding-left:env(safe-area-inset-left,0px);padding-right:env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)}
button{font-family:inherit}
#top{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:10;background:var(--bar);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 8px) 10px 8px}
#row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
#q{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:16px;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--hit);color:var(--fg);outline:none}
#q:focus{border-color:var(--acc)}
.b{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--hit);color:var(--fg);border-radius:10px;height:40px;min-width:40px;font-size:15px;padding:0 10px;cursor:pointer}
.b:active{background:var(--line)}
.b.pri{background:var(--acc);border-color:var(--acc);color:#06121f;font-weight:600}
#res{display:none;max-height:48vh;overflow:auto;margin-top:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bar)}
#res button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:none;color:var(--fg);font-size:15px}
#res button:last-child{border-bottom:0}
#res button:active{background:var(--hit)}
#res small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px}
#res .n{color:var(--mut);padding:11px 12px;font-size:14px}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;border-radius:6px;padding:1px 6px;margin-left:6px;background:#12344f;color:#8fd0ff;vertical-align:1px}
#view{position:fixed;inset:0;touch-action:none;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg)}
#stage{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform-origin:0 0;background:#0d131b;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #1d2836,0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#stage svg{display:block}
#dg path[data-f]{stroke-width:var(--lw,8)}
#dock{position:fixed;right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right,0px) + 12px);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 14px);z-index:10;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
#dock .b{height:46px;min-width:46px;font-size:20px;background:var(--bar);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
#dock .t{font-size:13px}
body.sheet #dock{display:none}
#zl{position:fixed;left:calc(env(safe-area-inset-left,0px) + 12px);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 14px);z-index:9;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);background:var(--bar);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:4px 8px}
body.sheet #zl{display:none}
.hsn{stroke:rgba(240,180,41,.55)!important;stroke-dasharray:2 1.5}
.hsr{fill:rgba(90,169,255,.04);stroke:rgba(90,169,255,.55);stroke-width:.7}
#sheet{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:20;background:var(--bar);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55);max-height:62vh;overflow:auto;padding:12px 14px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 14px);display:none}
body.sheet #sheet{display:block}
#sh-h{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px}
#sh-h h2{margin:0;font-size:19px;flex:1;word-break:break-all}
.badge{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;margin:6px 6px 0 0}
.ok{background:rgba(53,208,112,.16);color:var(--ok)} .bad{background:rgba(255,92,92,.16);color:var(--bad)} .warn{background:rgba(240,180,41,.16);color:var(--warn)} .info{background:#12344f;color:#8fd0ff}
dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:6px 14px;margin:12px 0;font-size:14px}
dt{color:var(--mut)} dd{margin:0;word-break:break-word}
.acts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:6px}
.acts .b,.acts a.b{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-decoration:none;flex:1 1 140px;height:44px}
#map{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;background:var(--bg);display:none}
body.maponly #map{display:block}
#mtop{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:2;background:var(--bar);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 8px) 10px 8px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
#mtop h3{margin:0;font-size:16px;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#mview{position:absolute;inset:0;touch-action:none}
#msvg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
#minfo{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:2;background:var(--bar);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px 16px 0 0;padding:12px 14px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 12px)}
#minfo .big{font-size:18px;font-weight:700}
#minfo p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
#msc{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 150px);z-index:2;font-size:11px;color:var(--mut)}
#msc i{display:block;height:5px;border:1.5px solid var(--mut);border-top:0;margin-bottom:2px}
#mn{position:absolute;right:14px;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 66px);z-index:2;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px;text-align:center;line-height:1.1}
#mechip{position:fixed;left:calc(env(safe-area-inset-left,0px) + 12px);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 50px);z-index:9;font-size:12px;color:var(--fg);background:var(--bar);border:1px solid #2b5a8a;border-radius:10px;padding:6px 10px;display:none;max-width:70vw;cursor:pointer}
body.sheet #mechip{display:none!important}
.nl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}.nl .b{height:auto;min-height:38px;text-align:left;padding:6px 10px;font-size:13px}
#lg{position:fixed;left:10px;z-index:12;background:var(--bar);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:8px;display:none;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5);min-width:170px}
#lg.on{display:block}
#lg button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;background:none;border:0;color:var(--fg);font-size:14px;padding:7px 6px;border-radius:8px;text-align:left}
#lg button.sel{background:var(--hit);outline:1px solid var(--acc)}
#lg i{width:26px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;flex:none}
#lg small{color:var(--mut);margin-left:auto;padding-left:8px}
#lg h4{margin:0 0 4px 6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 70px);transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:60;background:#223048;color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:14px;display:none;max-width:90vw}
</style>

/* ---------- generic pan / zoom ---------- */
function PZ(el,o){
  var s=1,tx=0,ty=0,pts={},moved=false,lastTap=0,self={};
  var min=o.min||0.02,max=o.max||40;
  function ap(){o.apply(tx,ty,s)}
  self.get=function(){return {tx:tx,ty:ty,s:s}};
  self.fitS=function(){var vw=el.clientWidth,vh=el.clientHeight-o.top()-o.bottom();return Math.min(vw/o.w,vh/o.h)*0.96};
  self.fit=function(){s=self.fitS();tx=(el.clientWidth-o.w*s)/2;ty=o.top()+((el.clientHeight-o.top()-o.bottom())-o.h*s)/2;ap()};
  self.zoomAt=function(cx,cy,ns){ns=Math.max(min,Math.min(max,ns));tx=cx-(cx-tx)*(ns/s);ty=cy-(cy-ty)*(ns/s);s=ns;ap()};
  self.focus=function(px,py,ns){ if(ns) s=Math.max(min,Math.min(max,ns));
    tx=el.clientWidth/2-px*s; ty=o.top()+(el.clientHeight-o.top()-o.bottom())/2-py*s; ap()};
  self.toContent=function(cx,cy){var r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return [(cx-r.left-tx)/s,(cy-r.top-ty)/s]};
  self.center=function(f){self.zoomAt(el.clientWidth/2,o.top()+(el.clientHeight-o.top()-o.bottom())/2,s*f)};
  self.set=function(a,b,c){tx=a;ty=b;s=c;ap()};
  el.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){try{el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(x){} pts[e.pointerId]={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};moved=false;});
  el.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
    var p=pts[e.pointerId]; if(!p) return; var ids=Object.keys(pts);
    if(ids.length===1){var dx=e.clientX-p.x,dy=e.clientY-p.y; if(!moved&&Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)<4) return; tx+=dx;ty+=dy;p.x=e.clientX;p.y=e.clientY;moved=true;ap();}
    else{var a=pts[ids[0]],b=pts[ids[1]],d0=Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y),cx0=(a.x+b.x)/2,cy0=(a.y+b.y)/2;
      p.x=e.clientX;p.y=e.clientY;var d1=Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y),cx1=(a.x+b.x)/2,cy1=(a.y+b.y)/2;
      if(d0>0){var ns=Math.max(min,Math.min(max,s*d1/d0));tx=cx1-(cx0-tx)*(ns/s);ty=cy1-(cy0-ty)*(ns/s);s=ns;} moved=true;ap();}
  });
  function up(e){var n=Object.keys(pts).length;delete pts[e.pointerId];
    if(n===1&&!moved&&e.type==='pointerup'){
      if(o.onTap&&o.onTap(e.clientX,e.clientY)) {lastTap=0;return}
      var t=Date.now(); if(t-lastTap<300){self.zoomAt(e.clientX,e.clientY,s*2.2);lastTap=0}else lastTap=t;
    }}
  el.addEventListener('pointerup',up);el.addEventListener('pointercancel',up);
  el.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){e.preventDefault();self.zoomAt(e.clientX,e.clientY,s*Math.exp(-e.deltaY*0.0015))},{passive:false});
  return self;
}
document.addEventListener('gesturestart',function(e){e.preventDefault()});

/* ---------- data helpers ---------- */
var cur=null, me=null, meWatch=null;
function byCode(c){for(var i=0;i<DEV.length;i++) if(DEV[i][0]===c) return DEV[i]; return null}
function hav(a,b,c,d){var R=6371000,r=Math.PI/180,x=(c-a)*r,y=(d-b)*r,h=Math.sin(x/2)*Math.sin(x/2)+Math.cos(a*r)*Math.cos(c*r)*Math.sin(y/2)*Math.sin(y/2);return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h))}
function brg(a,b,c,d){var r=Math.PI/180,y=Math.sin((d-b)*r)*Math.cos(c*r),x=Math.cos(a*r)*Math.sin(c*r)-Math.sin(a*r)*Math.cos(c*r)*Math.cos((d-b)*r);return (Math.atan2(y,x)/r+360)%360}
var DIRS=['เหนือ','ตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือ','ตะวันออก','ตะวันออกเฉียงใต้','ใต้','ตะวันตกเฉียงใต้','ตะวันตก','ตะวันตกเฉียงเหนือ'];
function dirName(b){return DIRS[Math.round(b/45)%8]}
function fmtD(m){return m>=1000?(m/1000).toFixed(2)+' กม.':Math.round(m)+' ม.'}
function badgeState(d){var h='';
  h+='<span class="badge '+(d[4]==='Open'?'bad':'ok')+'">สถานะ: '+esc(d[4])+'</span>';
  if(d[4]!==d[7]) h+='<span class="badge warn">ต่างจากสถานะปกติ ('+esc(d[7])+')</span>';
  return h}

function tH(){return $('top').offsetHeight}
var dz=PZ(view,{w:VB[2],h:VB[3],top:tH,bottom:function(){return document.body.classList.contains('sheet')?$('sheet').offsetHeight:0},min:0.05,max:14,
  apply:function(tx,ty,s){st.style.transform='translate('+tx+'px,'+ty+'px) scale('+s+')';zl.textContent=Math.round(s/dz.fitS()*100)+'%';updLW(s)},
  onTap:function(cx,cy){ var p=dz.toContent(cx,cy), s=dz.get().s, x=p[0]+VB[0], y=p[1]+VB[1], best=null, bd=1e9;
    HS.forEach(function(h){var dx=Math.max(Math.abs(x-h.x)-h.w/2,0),dy=Math.max(Math.abs(y-h.y)-h.h/2,0),d=Math.hypot(dx,dy); if(d<bd){bd=d;best=h}});
    if(best&&bd<=18/s){ if(best.kind==='l') showLoc(best.target,[best.x,best.y]); else if(best.kind==='d') select(best.target,{src:'diagram'}); else showNone(best.label,[best.x,best.y]); return true} return false}});
var HS=[],lwCur=0,DEVPOS={},locSet={};
function updLW(s){var v=Math.max(8,50/s);if(Math.abs(v-lwCur)/Math.max(v,1)>0.08){lwCur=v;$('dg').style.setProperty('--lw',v.toFixed(1))}}
var CODE_RE=/^\(?[A-Z]{2,3}\d{2}[A-Z]{1,3}-\d+\)?$/;
function strip(s){return s.replace(/^\(|\)$/g,'')}
function buildHS(){
  var g=$('hs');g.innerHTML='';HS=[];DEVPOS={};locSet={};
  DEV.forEach(function(d){if(d[6]&&d[6]!=='-')locSet[d[6]]=1});
  Object.keys(LAB).forEach(function(k){ if(!CODE_RE.test(k)) return;
    LAB[k].forEach(function(p){
      var cands=[strip(k)]; if(p[4]) cands.push(strip(p[4]));
      var kind='n',tg=strip(k);
      for(var i=0;i<cands.length;i++){var c=cands[i]; if(byCode(c)){kind='d';tg=c;break} if(locSet[c]){kind='l';tg=c;break}}
      var w=Math.max(p[2]+6,16),h=Math.max(p[3]+4,10);
      HS.push({label:k,kind:kind,target:tg,x:p[0],y:p[1],w:w,h:h});
      if(kind==='d'){(DEVPOS[tg]=DEVPOS[tg]||[]).push([p[0],p[1]])}
      var r=document.createElementNS(NS,'rect');r.setAttribute('class','hsr'+(kind==='n'?' hsn':''));r.setAttribute('x',p[0]-w/2);r.setAttribute('y',p[1]-h/2);r.setAttribute('width',w);r.setAttribute('height',h);r.setAttribute('rx',2);g.appendChild(r);
    })});
}
function mark(x,y){var g=$('hl');g.innerHTML='';
  var c=document.createElementNS(NS,'circle');c.setAttribute('cx',x);c.setAttribute('cy',y);c.setAttribute('r','8');c.setAttribute('fill','none');c.setAttribute('stroke','#ff4d4d');c.setAttribute('stroke-width','1.6');
  [['r','8','46'],['opacity','1','0']].forEach(function(a){var an=document.createElementNS(NS,'animate');an.setAttribute('attributeName',a[0]);an.setAttribute('from',a[1]);an.setAttribute('to',a[2]);an.setAttribute('dur','1.1s');an.setAttribute('repeatCount','5');c.appendChild(an)});
  g.appendChild(c)}
function focusDiagram(code){var p=(DEVPOS[code]||LAB[code]||[])[0]; if(!p) return false;
  closeMap(); setTimeout(function(){},0); dz.focus(p[0]-VB[0],p[1]-VB[1],Math.max(3,dz.get().s)); mark(p[0],p[1]); return true}

/* ---------- selection + detail sheet ---------- */
function navLinks(d){var ll=d[9]+','+d[10];
  return '<a class="b pri" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination='+ll+'&travelmode=driving">🧭 นำทาง (Google Maps)</a>'}
function select(code,opt){
  opt=opt||{}; var d=byCode(code);
  if(!d){ if(!focusDiagram(code)) toast('ไม่พบข้อมูลอุปกรณ์'); return }
  cur=d; var on=!!DEVPOS[code];
  renderSheet(); document.body.classList.add('sheet');
  if(opt.src!=='diagram'&&opt.src!=='map'&&on) focusDiagram(code);
  if(opt.src==='diagram'&&on){var p=DEVPOS[code][0];mark(p[0],p[1])}
  if(opt.src==='map') updateMapInfo();
}
function renderSheet(){
  var d=cur; if(!d){return}
  var on=!!DEVPOS[d[0]], h='<div id="sh-h"><h2>'+esc(d[0])+'</h2><button class="b" id="sh-x">✕</button></div>';
  h+='<div>'+badgeState(d)+'<span class="badge info">'+esc(d[1])+'</span>'+(on?'':'<span class="badge info">ไม่มีป้ายบนแผนผังนี้</span>')+'</div>';
  h+='<dl><dt>ระดับแรงดัน</dt><dd>'+esc(d[2])+'</dd><dt>วิธีการควบคุม</dt><dd>'+esc(d[3])+'</dd><dt>สถานะปกติ</dt><dd>'+esc(d[7])+'</dd>'+
     '<dt>กระแสลัดวงจรสูงสุด</dt><dd>'+esc(d[5])+'</dd><dt>สถานที่</dt><dd>'+esc(d[6])+'</dd><dt>สายป้อน</dt><dd>'+esc(d[8])+'</dd>'+
     '<dt>พิกัด</dt><dd>'+d[9].toFixed(6)+', '+d[10].toFixed(6)+'</dd>';
  if(me) h+='<dt>ระยะจากคุณ</dt><dd>'+fmtD(hav(me.lat,me.lon,d[9],d[10]))+' (เส้นตรง)</dd>';
  h+='</dl><div class="acts">'+navLinks(d)+'</div>';
  $('sheet').innerHTML=h;
  $('sh-x').onclick=closeSheet;
}
function showLoc(name,p){
  var L=DEV.filter(function(d){return d[6]===name}); cur=null;
  p=p||(LAB[name]||[])[0]; if(p) mark(p[0],p[1]);
  var h='<div id="sh-h"><h2>'+esc(name)+'</h2><button class="b" id="sh-x">✕</button></div><div><span class="badge info">อุปกรณ์ที่ติดตั้งในตำแหน่งนี้ '+L.length+' รายการ</span></div><div class="nl">';
  L.forEach(function(d,i){h+='<button class="b" data-i="'+i+'"><b>'+esc(d[0])+'</b> · '+esc(d[1])+' · <span style="color:var(--'+(d[4]==='Open'?'bad':'ok')+')">'+esc(d[4])+'</span></button>'});
  h+='</div>'; $('sheet').innerHTML=h; document.body.classList.add('sheet'); $('sh-x').onclick=closeSheet;
  Array.prototype.forEach.call($('sheet').querySelectorAll('.nl .b'),function(b){b.onclick=function(){select(L[+b.getAttribute('data-i')][0],{src:'diagram'})}});
}
function showNone(label,p){
  cur=null; if(p) mark(p[0],p[1]);
  var h='<div id="sh-h"><h2>'+esc(strip(label))+'</h2><button class="b" id="sh-x">✕</button></div><div><span class="badge warn">ไม่พบรหัสนี้ในไฟล์ Excel</span></div><p style="color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;margin:10px 0 0">ป้ายนี้ไม่มีข้อมูลรายละเอียด (ไม่ตรงกับรหัสอุปกรณ์หรือสถานที่ในไฟล์) หากรหัสบนแผนผังเปลี่ยนแล้ว แจ้งรหัสใหม่เพื่อปรับให้ตรงกัน</p>';
  $('sheet').innerHTML=h; document.body.classList.add('sheet'); $('sh-x').onclick=closeSheet;
}
function closeSheet(){document.body.classList.remove('sheet')}

/* ---------- search ---------- */
var q=$('q'),res=$('res');
function hideRes(){res.style.display='none'}
var LABKEYS=Object.keys(LAB).filter(function(k){return /^\(?[A-Z]{2,3}\d{2}[A-Z]{1,3}-\d+\)?$/.test(k)});
function run(){
  var v=q.value.trim().toLowerCase();res.innerHTML='';
  if(!v){hideRes();return}
  var m=DEV.filter(function(d){return (d[0]+' '+d[6]+' '+d[8]+' '+d[1]).toLowerCase().indexOf(v)>=0});
  var tot=m.length; m=m.slice(0,50);
  var seen={};DEV.forEach(function(d){seen[d[0]]=1});
  var extra=LABKEYS.filter(function(k){return !seen[k]&&k.toLowerCase().indexOf(v)>=0}).slice(0,15);
  if(!m.length&&!extra.length) res.innerHTML='<div class="n">ไม่พบรายการที่ตรงกัน</div>';
  m.forEach(function(d){var b=document.createElement('button');
    b.innerHTML=esc(d[0])+(DEVPOS[d[0]]?'<span class="tag">ในแผนผัง</span>':'')+'<small>'+esc(d[1])+' · สายป้อน '+esc(d[8])+' · '+esc(d[4])+'</small>';
    b.onclick=function(){hideRes();q.blur();select(d[0],{src:'search'})};res.appendChild(b)});
  if(tot>50){var n=document.createElement('div');n.className='n';n.textContent='แสดง 50 จาก '+tot+' รายการ – พิมพ์เพิ่มเพื่อกรอง';res.appendChild(n)}
  extra.forEach(function(k){var b=document.createElement('button');b.innerHTML=esc(k)+'<span class="tag">ป้ายในแผนผัง</span>';
    b.onclick=function(){hideRes();q.blur();closeSheet();focusDiagram(k)};res.appendChild(b)});
  res.style.display='block';
}
q.addEventListener('input',run);
q.addEventListener('focus',run);
$('bx').onclick=function(){q.value='';hideRes();$('hl').innerHTML='';closeSheet()};
$('bp').onclick=function(){dz.center(1.5)};$('bm').onclick=function(){dz.center(1/1.5)};$('bf').onclick=function(){dz.fit()};
/* ---------- feeder legend / highlight ---------- */

  var css='#dg[data-hl] [data-f]{opacity:.1}';
  Object.keys(FEED).forEach(function(f){css+='#dg[data-hl="'+f+'"] [data-f="'+f+'"]{opacity:1}'});
  var st2=document.createElement('style');st2.textContent=css;document.head.appendChild(st2);
  var lg=$('lg'),dg=$('dg');
  function build(){
    var cnt={};DEV.forEach(function(d){cnt[d[8]]=(cnt[d[8]]||0)+1});
    var h='<h4>สีสายป้อน (แตะเพื่อเน้น)</h4>',cur=dg.getAttribute('data-hl');
    Object.keys(FEED).forEach(function(f){h+='<button data-f="'+f+'" class="'+(cur===f?'sel':'')+'"><i style="background:'+FEED[f]+'"></i>'+f+'<small>'+(cnt[f]||0)+' อุปกรณ์</small></button>'});
    h+='<button data-f="" class="'+(cur?'':'sel')+'"><i style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff4fd8,#ffd23f,#4d94ff,#2ee6e6,#ff9a2e)"></i>แสดงทั้งหมด</button>';
    lg.innerHTML=h;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(lg.querySelectorAll('button'),function(b){b.onclick=function(){var f=b.getAttribute('data-f');if(f&&dg.getAttribute('data-hl')!==f)dg.setAttribute('data-hl',f);else dg.removeAttribute('data-hl');build()}});
  }
  $('bg').onclick=function(){lg.style.top=(tH()+8)+'px';build();lg.classList.toggle('on')};
})();
$('bl').onclick=function(){openMap();if(!me)locate(false)};
$('bn').onclick=function(){var s=view.clientWidth/400;dz.set(view.clientWidth/2-(EXT[0]-VB[0])*s,tH()+6-(395-VB[1])*s,s)};

/* ---------- my position on diagram ---------- */
var meNear=null;
function updateMeDiagram(){var g=$('mel'),c=$('mechip');g.innerHTML='';
  if(!me){c.style.display='none';return}
  var best=null,bd=1e18;DEV.forEach(function(d){if(!DEVPOS[d[0]])return;var m=hav(me.lat,me.lon,d[9],d[10]);if(m<bd){bd=m;best=d}});
  if(!best){c.style.display='none';return}
  meNear=best;var p=DEVPOS[best[0]][0];
  g.appendChild(mk('circle',{cx:p[0],cy:p[1]-9,r:4.5,fill:'#5aa9ff',stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':1.3}));
  var an=mk('circle',{cx:p[0],cy:p[1]-9,r:4.5,fill:'none',stroke:'#5aa9ff','stroke-width':1.3});
  [['r','4.5','26'],['opacity','1','0']].forEach(function(a){an.appendChild(mk('animate',{attributeName:a[0],from:a[1],to:a[2],dur:'1.6s',repeatCount:'indefinite'}))});g.appendChild(an);
  c.style.display='block';c.innerHTML='📍 ตำแหน่งฉัน – ใกล้ <b>'+esc(best[0])+'</b> ('+fmtD(bd)+')';
}
$('mechip').onclick=function(){if(meNear)focusDiagram(meNear[0])};
/* ---------- geo map ---------- */
var LAT0=DEV.reduce(function(a,d){return a+d[9]},0)/DEV.length, KX=111320*Math.cos(LAT0*Math.PI/180), KY=110574;
var mp={ox:0,oy:0,w:1,h:1}, mz=null, mView=$('mview'), mg=$('mg'), feeders={};
function proj(lat,lon){return [(lon-mp.lon0)*KX-mp.ox,(mp.lat1-lat)*KY-mp.oy]}
function fcol(f){if(FEED[f])return FEED[f];if(!feeders[f]){var n=Object.keys(feeders).length;feeders[f]='hsl('+((n*67)%360)+',75%,62%)'}return feeders[f]}
function mk(tag,at){var e=document.createElementNS(NS,tag);for(var k in at)e.setAttribute(k,at[k]);return e}
function drawMap(){
  mg.innerHTML=''; feeders={};
  var la=DEV.map(function(d){return d[9]}),lo=DEV.map(function(d){return d[10]});
  var pts=DEV.map(function(d){return [d[9],d[10]]});
  if(me)pts.push([me.lat,me.lon]);
  la=pts.map(function(p){return p[0]});lo=pts.map(function(p){return p[1]});
  var lat1=Math.max.apply(null,la),lat0=Math.min.apply(null,la),lon0=Math.min.apply(null,lo),lon1=Math.max.apply(null,lo);
  mp={lat1:lat1,lon0:lon0,ox:-300,oy:-300,w:(lon1-lon0)*KX+600,h:(lat1-lat0)*KY+600};
  var gr=mk('g',{stroke:'#1a2433','stroke-width':1,'vector-effect':'non-scaling-stroke'});
  for(var x=0;x<mp.w;x+=1000) gr.appendChild(mk('line',{x1:x,y1:0,x2:x,y2:mp.h,stroke:'#18212d','vector-effect':'non-scaling-stroke'}));
  for(var y=0;y<mp.h;y+=1000) gr.appendChild(mk('line',{x1:0,y1:y,x2:mp.w,y2:y,stroke:'#18212d','vector-effect':'non-scaling-stroke'}));
  mg.appendChild(gr);
  var lg=mk('g',{id:'mlink'});mg.appendChild(lg);
  DEV.forEach(function(d){var p=proj(d[0+9],d[10]);
    var c=mk('circle',{cx:p[0],cy:p[1],'data-r':d[4]==='Open'?5:3.6,fill:fcol(d[8]),stroke:d[4]==='Open'?'#ff5c5c':'none','stroke-width':1.5,'vector-effect':'non-scaling-stroke',opacity:.9});mg.appendChild(c)});
  mg.appendChild(mk('g',{id:'msel'}));mg.appendChild(mk('g',{id:'mme'}));
}
function sizeMarks(s){var a=mg.querySelectorAll('[data-r]');for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)a[i].setAttribute('r',(+a[i].getAttribute('data-r'))/s)}
function drawSel(){
  var g=$('msel');if(!g)return;g.innerHTML='';var gm=$('mme');gm.innerHTML='';$('mlink').innerHTML='';
  if(me){var pm=proj(me.lat,me.lon);
    gm.appendChild(mk('circle',{cx:pm[0],cy:pm[1],r:Math.max(me.acc||0,0),fill:'rgba(90,169,255,.12)',stroke:'rgba(90,169,255,.5)','vector-effect':'non-scaling-stroke'}));
    gm.appendChild(mk('circle',{cx:pm[0],cy:pm[1],'data-r':8,fill:'#5aa9ff',stroke:'#fff','stroke-width':3,'vector-effect':'non-scaling-stroke'}));
    var tm=mk('text',{x:pm[0],y:pm[1],'data-fs':13,fill:'#8fd0ff',stroke:'#0b1118','stroke-width':3,'paint-order':'stroke'});tm.textContent='ฉัน';gm.appendChild(tm)}
  if(cur){var p=proj(cur[9],cur[10]);
    var c=mk('circle',{cx:p[0],cy:p[1],'data-r':9,fill:'none',stroke:'#ff4d4d','stroke-width':3,'vector-effect':'non-scaling-stroke'});
    g.appendChild(c);g.appendChild(mk('circle',{cx:p[0],cy:p[1],'data-r':3.5,fill:'#ff4d4d'}));
    var t=mk('text',{x:p[0],y:p[1],'data-fs':13,fill:'#fff',stroke:'#0b1118','stroke-width':3,'paint-order':'stroke','text-anchor':'start'});t.textContent=cur[0];g.appendChild(t);
    if(me){var pm2=proj(me.lat,me.lon);$('mlink').appendChild(mk('line',{x1:pm2[0],y1:pm2[1],x2:p[0],y2:p[1],stroke:'#5aa9ff','stroke-width':2,'stroke-dasharray':'8 6','vector-effect':'non-scaling-stroke'}))}}
  sizeMarks(mz.get().s); sizeText(mz.get().s);
}
function sizeText(s){var a=mg.querySelectorAll('[data-fs]');for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++){var e=a[i],f=+e.getAttribute('data-fs')/s;e.setAttribute('font-size',f);e.setAttribute('dx',12/s);e.setAttribute('dy',-12/s);e.setAttribute('stroke-width',3/s)}}
function scaleBar(s){var L=[10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,20000],t=L[L.length-1];for(var i=0;i<L.length;i++){if(L[i]*s>=70){t=L[i];break}}
  $('msb').style.width=(t*s)+'px';$('mst').textContent=t>=1000?(t/1000)+' กม.':t+' ม.'}
var mzOpts={w:1,h:1,top:function(){return $('mtop').offsetHeight},bottom:function(){return $('minfo').offsetHeight},min:0.002,max:60,
  apply:function(tx,ty,s){mg.setAttribute('transform','translate('+tx+' '+ty+') scale('+s+')');sizeMarks(s);sizeText(s);scaleBar(s)},
  onTap:function(cx,cy){var p=mz.toContent(cx,cy),s=mz.get().s,best=null,bd=1e9;
    DEV.forEach(function(d){var pp=proj(d[9],d[10]),dd=Math.hypot(pp[0]-p[0],pp[1]-p[1]);if(dd<bd){bd=dd;best=d}});
    if(best&&bd*s<=22){select(best[0],{src:'map'});return true}return false}};
function initMapPZ(){ if(!mz) mz=PZ(mView,mzOpts); }
function fitAll(){mz.fit()}
function fitPair(){
  if(!cur){ if(me){var q0=proj(me.lat,me.lon);mz.focus(q0[0],q0[1],Math.max(mView.clientWidth,300)/3000);return} return fitAll(); }
  var a=proj(cur[9],cur[10]);
  if(!me){mz.focus(a[0],a[1],Math.max(view.clientWidth,300)/2500);return}
  var b=proj(me.lat,me.lon),mx=(a[0]+b[0])/2,my=(a[1]+b[1])/2,dx=Math.abs(a[0]-b[0])+400,dy=Math.abs(a[1]-b[1])+400;
  var vw=mView.clientWidth,vh=mView.clientHeight-$('mtop').offsetHeight-$('minfo').offsetHeight;
  mz.focus(mx,my,Math.min(vw/dx,vh/dy));
}
function openMap(d){
  if(d)cur=d;
  document.body.classList.add('maponly');initMapPZ();drawMap();
  mzSize();
  drawSel();updateMapInfo();fitPair();
  if(!me&&!openMap._asked){openMap._asked=1;locate(true)}
}
function mzSize(){ mzOpts.w=mp.w; mzOpts.h=mp.h }
function closeMap(){document.body.classList.remove('maponly')}
function updateMapInfo(){
  var el=$('minfo');if(!cur){
    if(!me){el.innerHTML='<p>แตะจุดบนแผนที่เพื่อเลือกอุปกรณ์ · กด 📍 เพื่อแสดงตำแหน่งของคุณ</p>'}
    else{var L=DEV.map(function(d){return [d,hav(me.lat,me.lon,d[9],d[10])]}).sort(function(a,b){return a[1]-b[1]}).slice(0,5);
      var h='<div class="big">ตำแหน่งของฉัน</div><p>±'+Math.round(me.acc||0)+' ม. · อุปกรณ์ใกล้ที่สุด:</p><div class="nl">';
      L.forEach(function(x,i){h+='<button class="b" data-i="'+i+'"><b>'+esc(x[0][0])+'</b> · '+fmtD(x[1])+' · '+esc(x[0][8])+'</button>'});
      el.innerHTML=h+'</div>';
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(el.querySelectorAll('.nl .b'),function(b){b.onclick=function(){select(L[+b.getAttribute('data-i')][0][0],{src:'map'})}})}
    $('msc').style.bottom=(el.offsetHeight+10)+'px';drawSel();return}
  $('mtitle').textContent=cur[0]+' · '+cur[8];
  var h='<div class="big">'+esc(cur[0])+'</div>';
  h+='<div>'+badgeState(cur)+'</div>';
  if(me){var dm=hav(me.lat,me.lon,cur[9],cur[10]),b=brg(me.lat,me.lon,cur[9],cur[10]);
    h+='<p>ระยะเส้นตรงจากตำแหน่งปัจจุบัน <b style="color:var(--fg)">'+fmtD(dm)+'</b> · ทิศ '+Math.round(b)+'° ('+dirName(b)+') · ความแม่นยำ ±'+Math.round(me.acc||0)+' ม.</p>';}
  else h+='<p>กด 📍 เพื่อใช้ตำแหน่งปัจจุบันของคุณ (เส้นประสีฟ้าคือแนวตรงถึงอุปกรณ์)</p>';
  h+='<div class="acts" style="margin-top:10px">'+navLinks(cur)+'<button class="b" id="mi-i">รายละเอียด</button></div>';
  el.innerHTML=h;$('msc').style.bottom=(el.offsetHeight+10)+'px';$('mi-i').onclick=function(){closeMap();renderSheet();document.body.classList.add('sheet')};
  drawSel();
}
function locate(quiet){
  if(!navigator.geolocation){if(!quiet)toast('อุปกรณ์นี้ไม่รองรับการระบุตำแหน่ง');return}
  if(meWatch!=null){if(me&&mz){fitPair()}return}
  meWatch=navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(function(p){
    me={lat:p.coords.latitude,lon:p.coords.longitude,acc:p.coords.accuracy};
    if(document.body.classList.contains('maponly')){var first=!locate._got;drawMap();mzSize();drawSel();updateMapInfo();if(first)fitPair()}
    locate._got=1; updateMeDiagram(); if(document.body.classList.contains('sheet')&&cur)renderSheet();
  },function(e){meWatch=null;if(!quiet)toast('ใช้ตำแหน่งปัจจุบันไม่ได้ – ตรวจสอบสิทธิ์ตำแหน่งของเบราว์เซอร์');},{enableHighAccuracy:true,maximumAge:5000,timeout:20000});
}
$('mclose').onclick=closeMap;$('mloc').onclick=function(){if(me){fitPair()}else locate(false)};$('mfit').onclick=fitAll;

/* ---------- import Excel ---------- */
$('bi').onclick=function(){$('fi').click()};
function loadLib(cb){if(window.XLSX)return cb();var s=document.createElement('script');s.src='https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js';s.onload=cb;s.onerror=function(){toast('โหลดตัวอ่าน Excel ไม่ได้')};document.head.appendChild(s)}
$('fi').onchange=function(){var f=this.files[0];if(!f)return;var rd=new FileReader();
  rd.onload=function(){loadLib(function(){try{
    var wb=XLSX.read(rd.result,{type:'array'}),ws=wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]],rows=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws,{header:1,defval:''});
    var hd=rows[0].map(function(x){return String(x).trim()}),ix=function(n){return hd.indexOf(n)};
    var c=['รหัสอุปกรณ์','ประเภทย่อยของสวิทช์','ระดับแรงดัน','วิธีการควบคุม','สถานะปัจจุบัน','ค่ากระแสลัดวงจรสูงสุด (kA)','สถานที่','สถานะปรกติ','รหัสสายป้อนที่ 1','LATITUDE','LONGITUDE'].map(ix);
    if(c.indexOf(-1)>=0){toast('หัวคอลัมน์ไม่ตรงกับรูปแบบไฟล์เดิม');return}
    var o=[];rows.slice(1).forEach(function(r){var la=parseFloat(r[c[9]]),lo=parseFloat(r[c[10]]);if(!r[c[0]]||isNaN(la)||isNaN(lo))return;
      o.push([String(r[c[0]]).trim(),String(r[c[1]]).trim(),String(r[c[2]]).trim(),String(r[c[3]]).trim(),String(r[c[4]]).trim(),String(r[c[5]]).trim(),String(r[c[6]]).trim(),String(r[c[7]]).trim(),String(r[c[8]]).trim(),la,lo])});
    if(!o.length){toast('ไม่พบข้อมูลอุปกรณ์ในไฟล์');return}
    DEV=o;try{localStorage.setItem('mvtha_dev',JSON.stringify(o))}catch(e){}
    buildHS();cur=null;closeSheet();toast('นำเข้า '+o.length+' อุปกรณ์แล้ว');
  }catch(e){toast('อ่านไฟล์ไม่สำเร็จ')}})};rd.readAsArrayBuffer(f);this.value=''};

buildHS(); dz.fit();
view.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(){hideRes();q.blur()});
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
